name: accel_configure
description: Base configuration per chip. LIS3DH-map chips (0x11/0x28): CTRL3=0, CLICK_CFG=0, CTRL1=0x37 (25 Hz XYZ), CTRL4=0x90, CTRL5=0x40 (FIFO), FIFO_CTRL=0 then 0x80 (stream). Chip 0x23: base preset + int. LIS2DW12 (0x44): 0x25=0x10, 0x3f=0, 0x25=0x50, 0x2e=0xdf, CTRL1=0x32, 0x23=0, 0x22=0. Chip 0x48: bit tweaks in 0x10..0x16.

name: accel_probe_chip
description: Detects the accelerometer by WHO_AM_I. Tries I2C 0x19 reg 0x70 first: if it answers, writes 0x21=0x44 and reads 0x0F -> 0x44 (LIS2DW12) else assumes 0x11 (SC7A20, LIS3DH register map). Otherwise resets a 0x1F device (reg 0x14=0xB6) and reads reg 0 -> 0x23, else enables a 0x20 device (reg 0x3E=1) and reads 0x0F -> 0x48. Result in accel_chip_id.

name: accel_init
description: Probe + per-chip bring-up. Returns 1 when a supported chip (0x11, 0x23, 0x28, 0x44, 0x48) initialised. NOTE: a genuine LIS3DH (id 0x33) is NOT accepted.

name: gsensor_process_samples
description: APP-TASK ACCELEROMETER PIPELINE. Consumes new FIFO samples, remaps axes per chip (0x44/0x28: swap+negate; 0x23: as-is; others: y,-x style), feeds pedo_feed_sample, and runs the SHAKE detector: in camera mode, >10 consecutive samples with motion magnitude >= 0x7d1 -> send_camera_event(2) and a 3 s cooldown timer.
